overall_reason: A violet-to-pink-to-amber gradient fills the stage, a lavender-to-pink wash fills the card, the heading is gradient text, and every text element and status icon is violet (#4c1d95 or #a78bfa), so there is no neutral ink and no state colour.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds washes and gradient text with no source, T-ACCENT-DOSAGE finds the accent on every label and icon, and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds all three states in one violet.

findings.title: No gradient text, orbs or washes
findings.where: stage, card background and heading 'Recent deploys', 1440 and 375, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P48\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table lists 4 gradients: the stage #7c3aed to #db2777 to #f59e0b, the card wash #faf5ff to #fdf2f8 and the gradient-filled heading and button. The sweep's gradient detector flags the stage and the heading (SLP-007).
findings.before: Gradient stage, tinted card wash and gradient heading text
findings.after: A neutral card on a plain ground, with the heading in ink and colour kept for the action
findings.why: The washes and gradient text decorate every layer, so nothing in the card is marked by colour any more.

findings.title: The accent marks action and state
findings.where: row titles, meta, times and icons, 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P48\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table finds no neutral text: #4c1d95 on 3 titles and #a78bfa on 4 meta and time labels, with the icons in the same violet; the neutral temperature count is empty.
findings.before: Violet on every label, time and icon
findings.after: Ink for titles, a neutral grey for meta, and the accent only on the action
findings.why: An accent on every element stops marking the action.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.evidence: The live globe, the building spinner and the failed cross are all the same violet; in the tile the failed deploy looks the same as the live one.
findings.before: One violet for live, building and failed
findings.after: A distinct, fixed colour per state (with the icon shape as a second cue)
findings.why: A failed deploy must not look like a successful one.

strengths: The status icons still differ in shape, so the state can be recovered without colour.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
